blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Senior bowler Dory Enoveso outplayed a pair of younger contenders to capture the Sugbuanon Bowlers United (SUGBU) Shootout Tournament on Sunday, September 27, in the SM Seaside Bowling and Leisure Center. Enoveso survived a tightly contested four-game series, finishing with 832 pinfalls and narrowly claiming the championship. Her 48 handicap points proved crucial as she held off fellow top-three finishers in the final rankings. Enoveso posted 220 pinfalls in her best game and averaged 208 pinfalls, including her handicap points, throughout the four-game series.
